repairrange.voice: Plain, useful, no hype. Australian spelling. Written for someone deciding whether to pay for a repair. Editorial only - never tech news, that lives on tech-news.html.
guardrails: NEVER state, estimate, imply or invent a price for any repair, part or service. If cost must be discussed, describe the factors that drive it and link to the calculator. Any dollar figure is an automatic fail.
Link to mayfieldphonerepair.com.au at most once, only where a Newcastle/Hunter reader would genuinely want a local shop. Must read as editorial, not a plug.

brand.voice_note: Voltly theme. Speaks to a confident DIYer who has already decided to try the repair.

selfrepairkit.voice: Instructional, second person, calm. Australian spelling. Assumes the reader has hands and a screwdriver, not an engineering degree.
guardrails: NEVER state or estimate a price for any kit, part or service. Link to the product page and let the store show the price.
Always include a safety note for battery and screen work (disconnect battery first, eye protection, no metal tools near the cell).
Do not claim a repair is easy. State the realistic difficulty and the failure modes.

pdfrange.voice: Sharp, privacy-forward, slightly opinionated. Written for someone who just realised their PDF got uploaded to a stranger's server.
guardrails: Do not name a competitor and assert they leak, sell or mishandle data. Describe the architectural difference (browser-side vs server-side) without accusing anyone.
Every post must end with one contextual link to the lead magnet or library.html - not a hard sell.

mayfieldgadgets.voice: Warm, local, straight-talking. Australian spelling. Written for a Newcastle buyer weighing refurbished against new.
guardrails: NEVER state or estimate a product price. Link to the product page.

NEVER make a quantified environmental or CO2 claim (e.g. 'saves 80kg of CO2'). No carbon maths, no e-waste tonnage, no sourced-sounding sustainability statistics. You may say refurbished extends a device's life. Nothing numeric.
Do not claim warranty terms, battery health percentages or grading standards beyond: 90-day warranty, Australia-only shipping.
